stations.title: Imran
stations.say: Can the price live outside the code?

stations.title: The bill script
stations.text: The price is a number written in the code.

stations.title: Shed screen
stations.text: The bill shows. The key never does.

captions: At Marrowfield, Imran asks for the water price to live outside the bill script.
Today he edits the number in the code every April, and last year he edited the wrong one.
You write the scripts that read their settings from the environment, in four tasks.
Now the price is a setting, and the bill uses this year's price without a code change.
Same April bill, no code edited. And the company's key never shows on the screen.
